sv.title: Smittrisk vid tandvårdsbesök – erbjuds hivtest
sv.summary: Region Kronoberg kan inte utesluta att otillräckligt rengjorda instrument lett till smitta av hiv på en tandvårdsmottagning i Växjö. Nu erbjuds omkring 1 500 personer provtagning.

en.title: Infection risk at dental visits – HIV tests offered
en.summary: Region Kronoberg cannot rule out that insufficiently cleaned instruments led to HIV transmission at a dental clinic in Växjö. Around 1,500 people are now being offered sampling.
